messages:
Priya (Product): Thanks everyone — quick follow-up from today’s all-hands re: customer wins/losses. Wanted to capture why we won, why we lost, and the top asks so we can close feedback loops. Drop Qs or notes and leadership will chime in.
Marcus (Head of Sales): Quick summary from sales side: Win — FinTech customer chose us for predictable latency and dedicated pool guarantees. Loss — large retailer went with competitor for on-prem KMS + longer data retention.
Maya (CS): Can we get a bulleted list of the top asks we heard across deals? I can map to support/enablement work.
Diego (SE): From pre-sales notes on the retailer loss: main technical blockers were KMS integration + compliance audit timeline. Also they flagged cold-start p99 spikes. Example from eval: `p99 = 210ms` on burst tests vs required <150ms.
Noah (Infra): For the p99 spikes — we saw KV-cache warming issues on some quantized models after autoscale events. Ops tuned evictions but need smarter pre-warm policies.
Marcus (Head of Sales): Top asks I heard: 1) Customer-managed KMS/HSM 2) Longer log/trace retention for audits 3) VPC/private control plane 4) SLA on tail latency. Those four are ~80% of close friction.
Ellen (CEO): Thanks — good list. Strategic priorities: short-term (60d) — KMS integration + audit docs + clear messaging on Dedicated SLAs. Medium-term (quarter) — private control plane improvements and retention options. We won’t duplicate everything but must remove blockers for enterprise deals.
Priya (Product): Action items: Marcus — list top 8 accounts blocked by KMS/retention this week. Diego + Noah — propose a 60d mitigation plan for p99 (pre-warm + cache warm hooks). Maya — draft customer-facing audit checklist. I'll consolidate and schedule a follow-up next Tues.
Maya (CS): Got it — will share audit checklist draft by Wed EOD.
Diego (SE): For the mitigation plan I'm thinking: 1) warm hooks on canary rollout 2) small standby warm pool 3) telemetry to detect cold-starts. Will draft runbook.
Noah (Infra): I'll add an infra ticket for warm pool and a perf test to reproduce p99 under burst.
Marcus (Head of Sales): If legal/compliance needs a stopgap, can we give a one-off attestation and extended support while KMS is in dev? Would speed some closures.
Ellen (CEO): We can evaluate attestation on a case-by-case basis; product/security must sign off. Priya, sync with Legal & Sec and include criteria in the follow-up doc.
Priya (Product): Will do. Also linking notes from today: https://go.redwood/ah-notes-2026-03-23 and I’ll create a GH project for the action items.
All-Hands Bot: Reminder set — follow-up meeting "Customer blocker triage" scheduled Tue 09:00 PT. Notes doc posted.
Marcus (Head of Sales): Thanks everyone. Small ask — can we have a customer-facing one-pager that explains our Dedicated vs Private SLAs/controls? Sales needs it in 2 weeks.
Priya (Product): On it — adding to the action list.
Ellen (CEO): Great thread. Keep these short updates in the doc so we can track progress. :thumbsup:
